Class Stopwatch

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.core.time.Stopwatch
public final class Stopwatch extends Object
Measures elapsed time, on a Ticker rather than on the wall clock. 
Stopwatch stopwatch = Stopwatch.started();
doSomething();
log.info("Done in {}", stopwatch);  // Done in 1.234 s

A stopwatch is either running or stopped. While stopped, its elapsed time does not change; starting it again resumes counting from there. A stopwatch is mutable and not thread-safe.
